# Pass 35 — the legacy performance audit (generated by tools/audit-performance.mjs; do not edit by hand)

Revision cb2460d934f4 · 87 legacy fields on 47 pathways · dispositions: different-architecture 2 · wrong-quantity 4 · model-only 1 · benchmark-not-bound 1 · unsupported-generic 5 · migrate-to-measurement 4 · ambiguous-basis 39 · verified-same-architecture 31 · actions: rewritten 8 · removed 35 · migrated 5 · kept-visible 9 · kept 30.

Policy (from the dispositions file):
- **record** — a legacy efficiency_record stays only when a named same-architecture source supports that quantity with a stated basis; one exactly represented by a structured physical measurement is deleted and the display derived (findings 20, 27–28)
- **typical** — a typical needs a population source — a review or handbook characterising a range, or enough curated measurements to derive one under an explicit population rule (never one or two measurements); pass 35 removed every stored efficiency_typical (a value cited only to a single paper, a discovery paper or a projection is unsupported-generic; one cited to a book or review whose page is unread is ambiguous-basis) and the field is no longer writable — a typical returns only with the page that supports it, as a derived quantity (findings 2–7 of the pass-35 reply)
- **limit** — a theoretical_limit stays when it states a physical bound with its basis; a representative operating point presented as a number, an operating-state temperature used as a reservoir, a projection for a different architecture, or an arithmetic error is rewritten or removed (findings 22–24)

Columns: *value at audit* is the field's value when the audit was taken (`was` in the dispositions file for fields since changed, else the current value); *pathway architecture* is the route length, the transducer(s) recorded and the status; *source support* says whether a named source supports that quantity for this architecture (yes / unverified / no); *basis known* whether the quantity's definition (net or gross, LHV or HHV, cell or module, engine or system) is stated.
